entries.written_notes_note: These notes come from the developer's announcement on Discord. The game's data feed has not caught up with this patch yet, so the details might change.
changes: A few numbers first shared on Discord didn't match the game's own data — the values here are the game's.
It is an alpha — meta and damage will keep changing.
Buffs for everyone:
Endgame monsters — Rupture Level 200 and every Riven Tier, Guardians included — have 10% less life and deal 5% less damage.
Skill damage at gem 20:
Cyclone x4.3, Rending Slam x3.5 (from gem 16), Death Coil x3.5, Storm Whirl x3.4, Drain Life x5.5 at gem 20, Caustic Arrow x2.3, Holy Elemental x2.
Dual wielding: 25% more attack speed (was 10%).
Entropy (Chaos support): Entropy from your hits now pays its full share (was half).
Grounded Storm (Mage Ascendancy): forced crit ailments keep their full crit bonus, x1.18.
Heralds: new Resonance — +12% per other sworn Herald or Woe aura of the same element. Heralds now give 15% at gem 20 (was 19.5%); Rot and Steel 13.5% (was 17.55%).
Nerfs:
The Long Battery: 2% more per Ballista or Totem (was 4%); 1 to 2% (was 3 to 4%).
Bina's Spotter's Helm: ramp to 10% more (was 25%); new totems no longer reset the volley; Arc totem x0.64.
Blood Ledger: Slam Entropy 5% more (was 20%).
Glass Cannon: minion damage 12% more (was 25%).
Pyre Covenant and Marrow Lord: minions 6% less; Pyre Covenant loses its 23% increased minion damage.
Gravebloom Oathword: minion damage 102 (was 251).
Entropy lines: Pact of Ruin 6% (was 12%); Entropic Focus 11% (was 22%); Gathering Dark support 10% (was 20%); Quarry's Debt 12 (was 25); Ruin Fletching 10 (was 20).
Inevitable Judgement and Moonlit Stance: crit ailments lose the Ascendancy crit bonus.
The Blackbile Censer and The Blackbile Seal: Poison chance, Poison damage and Ailment Duration rolls about halved.
Riven gem level lines: the top tier costs 4 Rivenstones and drops 4x rarer.
Target farming:
Guardian kills drop Red Shards — shards of 8 reds, each from one land, Guardian or Riven Lord (its tooltip says where).
Oathbind (Forge): makes the red from 6 shards, a plain base and 3 Oathsteel. Riven Bind adds 6 Rivenstones for the best rolls.
Red Forge (Forge): makes a red from 1 Forgeheart, 20 Gloomsilver, 40 Oathsteel, 2M gold and a plain base, costing x1.5 more each time this league.
Rivenhold (Forge): 24 Rivenstones cut a Dwarven Rune Socket into a rare ring, belt or boots.
Loot:
Rivenstone and Forgeheart drop with a tall ember gold beam and their own sound; Oathsteel and Gloomsilver with a cold white beam and a soft chime.
New Clear loot filter preset; your own filter is unchanged.
Rare and named monsters carry 35% of a Guardian's Oathsteel and Gloomsilver.
Map cards name the 2 reds that drop 4x more there; the Rupture end card shows your Sigil stake and return.
Fixes:
Co-op join from Steam invites; gamepad works on every screen.
Guardian life bar shows its hold phase.
Catacombs cart stalls, the Elven Capital wagon freeze and AMD graphics hangs are fixed.
Faster Rupture loads; the download is 160 MB smaller.

changes: A few numbers first shared on Discord didn't match the game's own data — the values here are the game's.

Drain Life: x1.6 damage at early gem levels.

Pyre of Faith: less hit damage at gem levels 1–17 and its burn no longer ignites, but 22% more damage at gem 20.

Arcane Lattice: the +1 Totem is gone — now 15% increased Totem damage.
Halo of the Restless Saint and Quarrybreaker Fists drop much less often.
New suffix on amulets, belts and Energy Shield armour: 6–22% faster Energy Shield recharge.
Minions and corpses:
Each minion kind past the second makes every kind reserve 25% more Mana.
Kindled Remains deals 25.2% of corpse life at Rupture Level 50–99 and 28.8% from level 100.
Two new Necromancer notables: Pyre Procession and Funeral Ash.
Grave Psalter leaves a Husk when a boss is hit; Charnel Bell raises Husks as Skeleton Warriors.
Endgame and the tree:
New Guardian: The Oathsmith, a Rupture Level 1–100 climb boss.
Guardian kills at Rupture Level 105, 115, 125, 135 and 145 each give 1 passive point, once per hero.
Passive tree: 18 new shortcut links; no node moved.
Drop tiers now cap at Rupture Level or hero level +5.
Cube:
Family Imbuing now uses 1 jewel (was 3).

Developer's notes:
Changes:
Split Shot: 20% less damage at gem level 20. Thornwake Bleeding 15 to 22% more (was 30 to 45%).
Bladesong on a bow keeps 24% increased Physical Damage (was about 200%); Maelstrom on a bow 1/1.75 as large. Melee unchanged. Bow Oathwords: Heartseeker, Viperstring, Windrider, Stormlash.
Hallowed Slam: 35% less damage at gem level 20 and up. Sure Strike Bleeding 36% more (was 57%). Twinscar: 1 extra Bleed (was 3), Physical Damage 30% lower.
Reliquary of the Second Dawn: 20% less Holy Spell Damage. Judgement with it about 20% less.
Barrowking's Mandate: +1 to every minion limit (was +3). Poison minions count Physical damage at half for Poison.
Trap: each Trap past the first adds 5% (was 20%). Iron Garrison, Second Battery and Circle of Stones give 15% increased Totem damage instead of a totem (points refunded).
Curses: Dread and Curse Effect add instead of multiplying. Evasion into damage halved, Energy Shield into damage 25% less. Entropy implosions 20% less.

Summon Skeletons and Raise Zombie: 25% more damage at gem level 20. Oath of the Living Storm, White Silence, Wind and Steel and Signet of the Lost Order go up. Hunter's Mark fits every Projectile skill.
New:
16 new red Oath Sigils, 21 in all, each a harder map with its promise on the card. Crimson Ink on the Riven Atlas: 50% more red Oath Sigils.
12 new chase reds from Pinnacle bosses at RL 170+, Riven Lords, Riven Tier 50+ Guardians and Cores.
Dragonling Void Aspect. Entropy lines on rare items and idols. Idol Filling in the Cube. Qhikazar prize cards pay more.
Events show their stakes and your co op friend sees the whole show. 1 in 3 Cursed Hoards is a defence.
Pack kills no longer blink out, elemental golem kills crush in their element, harsh sounds quieter.
Online:
Market inbox and Capital rooms are on. Ladders rank by Rupture Level, then Riven Tier; hero level no longer counts.
Co op: a carried hero's fast climb never refuses a save.
Full notes with every number are in the patch notes post.
Press F8 if something feels off.

Developer's notes:
Chaos damage, 5 Golem gems, 87 red uniques rewritten, defence no longer doubles as damage, better events and a fixed Catacombs. It is an alpha playtest: meta and damage will keep changing.
Per class (net, median hero):
Mage STRONGER x1.17. Paladin WEAKER x0.84. Ranger, Warrior, Necromancer and Samurai about even.
Buffs: Death Coil, Venom Spark, Ember Bolt, Winter Orb, Storm Spark, Cyclone, Pyre of Faith, Lightning Arrow, Thousand Cuts, Raise Zombie.
Nerfs: Tear cashes at most 4 seconds of a Bleed. Shuriken Fan 19% less. Heralds count a converted hit once. Skyfall counts Increased Area once. Sure Strike Bleeding 57% more (was 120%).
One node per defence still turns it into damage: Bastion's Reckoning (Armour), Fleet Shadow (Evasion), Swift Ward (Energy Shield), Oathstone Body (Life), Dawnmarch (Block).
21 other nodes lose that line and refund their points. Ironclad Fury pays for Armour only.
Hit hardest, 15 to 34%: Shield Throw, Shuriken Fan, Pyre of Faith, Judgement, Split Shot and Hallowed Slam stackers. Spend the refund on your defence's keystone.
Chaos damage (new):
Hits lay Entropy on enemies. It implodes 3 seconds later as Chaos damage that ignores Armour and elemental Resistance, and an enemy that dies owing Entropy bursts onto the pack.
A Chaos support, 5 chaos supports, one chaos keystone per class (any class can take any), 7 chaos reds and 6 chaos Oathwords.
Golems (new):
Grave, Flame, Ice, Storm and Venom Golem are their own gems, each with a blessing near it (Life regen, burning kills, Chill, Shock, more damage taken).
Press the gem again to send your golem leaping where you aim.
Red uniques:
87 reds now use the game's own lines: Sentence, Fury, Woes, item Oaths and Dragonling relics. Reds you own take the new lines when you log in.
NERFS on owned reds: The Regent's Thirst, Stormstring, Ashbrand of the Tyrant, Oathbreaker, The Thunder Psalm, Thunderstead Shield and Stormcaller's Fletching lose power.
19 retired count lines return on mega rare Primal twins. 16 new endgame reds.
Red uniques start dropping at monster level 35 (was 10).
Events and endgame:
Catacombs is fixed: the cart no longer stalls at the crypt. The first clear always pays Gloomsilver.
Qhikazar opens 3 prize cards; you pick one.
The Courier walks a patrol and turns on you. The Obelisk has 6 waves, Hoards and Warding Circles bring more monsters, Orsk guards a full Hoard, Hordes hold up to 28 enemies.
Into the Wound pays better reds at Depth 4 and 5. The Bounty hunter can drop a second chase unique.
Guardian life set from real kill times. Arena walls fall when the Guardian dies, and no rock stands inside an arena.
Gnome Realms has its own entry page with a map.
Interface, feel, audio:
Panels fade in and out. Drop banners are one line. Chat names line up. Tooltip ranges show the true top roll. Every support gem has its own icon.
Packs die on one beat with the element's light. The kill streak keeps its embers and adds a warm light; the magic circle is gone.
32 boss sounds remixed, harsh cues removed, Lightning Arrow 3.5 dB softer.
The shader cache ships with the game: far fewer hitches the first time you enter a land.
